<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Delgren the Purifier might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>

78088.description:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
78088.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
78088.title: A Strange Artifact

78093.description: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
78093.objectivesText: Return the Orb Shards to Delgren.
78093.title: Return to Delgren

78916.description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78916.objectivesText: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
78916.title: The Heart of the Void

78917.description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78917.objectivesText: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
78917.title: The Heart of the Void

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79192.description: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectivesText: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79360.completionText: Bring the Tattered Note to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles.
79360.description:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360.objectivesText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
79360.title: Elemental Aid

79361.description:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79362.description:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
79362.objectivesText: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.
79362.title: Grant's Shield

79364.completionText: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.description:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a shaman who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful shaman like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364.objectivesText: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.title: Eyes on the Sky

79365.description: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.objectivesText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.
79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79624.description:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.objectivesText: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79980.description: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

86574.description:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.
86574.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

86667.description:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.objectivesText: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.
86667.title: Snowbound

86757.description:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

87318.description:
Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
87318.title: Hearts of the Lost

87491.areaDescription: Escort the fire elemental out of Dun Modr
87491.description:
Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!
87491.objectivesText: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.
87491.title: Spark of Freedom

88757.description:
While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear!

It looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things!

If you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.
88757.objectivesText: Bring back Essene's Necklace, Essene's Spellbook, and Essene's Waterskin.
88757.title: Accessories of the Lost

88758.description:
I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here!

If you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!
88758.objectivesText: Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.
88758.title: Sentiments of the Lost

91208.description:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

objectives.text: Offer aid to the Frightened Paladin

91208.objectivesText: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
91208.title: Coming to Terms

91209.description:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

objectives.text: Report to Shari Stilwell in Brill

91209.objectivesText: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
91209.title: Continue Your Training

91282.description:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.objectivesText: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
91282.title: A Second Home

91285.description:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91732.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.title: Good Steel

91741.description:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.objectivesText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
91741.title: Nibbled-On Book

91745.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.objectivesText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.title: Mining Consultant

91752.description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.objectivesText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.title: The Big Picture

91753.description:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.objectivesText:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.objectivesText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772.description:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.objectivesText: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
91772.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.title: Book Return

91859.description:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
91859.title: A Curious Pair

91920.description:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.title: Wild Eyes

92110.description:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110.objectivesText: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92110.title: My First Real Potion

92401.areaDescription: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.description:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.title: A Frightened Request

92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.title: Light's Justice

92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $n.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92454.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
92454.objectivesText: Bring the Thendal Grove Gift Voucher to Dalia Windbreeze.
92454.title: Welcome!

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If I have to teach you herbalism you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.

92456.description:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456.objectivesText: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
92456.title: A Green Sample

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92460.description:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.title: Coming of Age

92466.description:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.objectivesText: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.title: Call of Earth

92468.description: Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.$B$BBe patient, $n. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
92468.objectivesText: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
92468.title: Call of Earth

92471.description:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471.objectivesText: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
92471.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92481.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481.objectivesText: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
92481.title: A Student of the Arcane

92482.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
92482.title: The Way of the Hunter

92489.description:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.objectivesText: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.
92489.title: Power Overwhelming

92515.description:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.objectivesText: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
92515.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92517.description:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.title: The Criminal Element

92528.description:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528.objectivesText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92528.title: Among the Faithful

92532.description:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.objectivesText: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.title: The Warrior's Path

92544.description:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544.objectivesText: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
92544.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92553.description:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.title: Restocking the Larders

92579.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92579.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.title: To Valanaar

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.> 

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Even for a Shaman, you show particular aptitude in our gift.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

92595.description:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595.objectivesText: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
92595.title: The Windshapers

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even for a mage such as yourself. 

Come, let us sit and speak some on the nature of the arcane and the plight of our homeland.

92596.description:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.title: The High Order

92642.description:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642.objectivesText: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92642.title: Disrupting Logistics

92679.description:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.title: Blood Tithe

92682.description:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.objectivesText: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.title: Make Yourself Useful

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.title: Standing Our Ground

92699.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699.title: The Supreme Magister

92700.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92700.title: The Grand Skyseer

92742.description:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.objectivesText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
92742.title: Testing the Wells

92743.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92744.description:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744.objectivesText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
92744.title: Murloc Gills

92748.description:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748.objectivesText: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
92748.title: Explosive Consultation

92752.description: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752.objectivesText: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
92752.title: Explosive Consultation

92753.description:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753.objectivesText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
92753.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92754.description:
Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.

Despite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.

What matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
92754.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.
92754.title: A New Need for Shadow Protection

92755.description:
With each passing day, our scavengers return with fewer and fewer armaments from fallen adventurers.

While we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.

I am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
92755.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring $1oa Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92755.title: Mysterious Mysticism

92814.description:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92814.title: I Need a Tailor

92818.description:
WE NEED MORE WEAPONS.

MORE. WEAPONS.

HOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS?

I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES.

HURRY UP.
92818.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.
92818.title: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes

92834.description:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
92834.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840.description:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92880.description:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880.objectivesText: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.title: Return to Valanaar

92881.description:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92894.description:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.
92894.title: Bone Raising

93034.description:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, $n. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.
93034.title: Valley of Bones

93036.description:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.objectivesText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93037.description:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

$n, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring $1oa Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.
93037.title: Outing Outcasts

93058.description:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

$n, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
93058.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue $1oa Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.
93058.title: Saving Our Own

93062.description:
About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic?

I noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt.

Laying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits.
93062.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from $1oa failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones.
93062.title: Bone Burying

93065.description: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.title: Prepare for Battle

93125.areaDescription: Escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway
93125.description:
You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!

Please help.
93125.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.
93125.title: Going Home

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93160.description:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.title: The Forest's Bounty

93165.description:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
93165.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93225.description:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93226.description:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
93226.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

93317.description:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317.objectivesText: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
93317.title: Crab Season

93318.description:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.objectivesText: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93429.description:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?
93429.objectivesText: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
93429.title: Blood of My Blood

93430.description:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, $r!
93430.objectivesText: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.
93430.title: Taking the Bait Back

93736.description:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.objectivesText: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737.description:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

objectives.text: Listen to what Riaani Nightwind has to say
Obtain Crystallized lightning from the Shriekling Cave
Obtain Enchanted Gyrozephyr from Windsong Lake
Obtain Air Construct Core from the Bandit Camp

93737.objectivesText: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
93737.title: The Broken Construct

93740.description:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
93740.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93740.title: Blood for Blood

93836.description:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93836.title: The Fate of Zephras

93927.description: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927.objectivesText: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
93927.title: A Last Request

93948.description:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948.objectivesText: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93948.title: Deliver the Signet

93963.description:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.objectivesText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.title: Exploring the Alliance

94004.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94004.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94004.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength

94007.description:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.objectivesText: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94007.title: Taming the Beast

94013.description:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
94013.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94013.title: Taming the Beast

94050.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050.objectivesText: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.title: Training the Beast
